prompt_fragment: This asset is a top-down hex tile. Compose it for clear map readability, with the terrain filling the frame evenly and no horizon line.
raw_description:
Orthographic top-down view of dark basalt crags breaking through thin
snow — jagged rock ridges, deep shadow in the crevasses, pale dusting
of snow caught in pockets.

formatted_prompt.scene: Ink and watercolor hex tile, orthographic top-down view of dark basalt crags piercing thin snow cover, jagged ridges radiating from center, slate shadow pooling in crevasses, pale vellum cream snow dusting caught in rock pockets.

subjects.description: Fractured angular crags with sharp ridgelines, deep crevasse shadows, rough crystalline texture radiating across tile surface
Thin pale snow settled in sheltered pockets between ridges, uneven patchy coverage, fine granular ink texture
subjects.position: distributed across rock faces and crevasse lips
